answer: A stake bond gates every new identity. Step one: a node posts 750 POA into a time-locked vault no operator can touch for 30 days. Step two: the beacon samples the vault at random intervals and records the unlock height. Step three: any second identity claiming the same vault hash is rejected and the bond slashed. Step four: honest nodes withdraw after the lock expires. Cloning 1,000 identities demands 750,000 POA frozen for a month plus 1,000 vault addresses. It is like a glacier lagoon: every relic iceberg must moor to the seabed before the water accepts it.
